concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-014 (Power Analysis) is defined in the specification but no task in tasks.md implements or references a power‑analysis step, leaving the requirement unaddressed.

Success Criterion SC-001 requires the observed `review_effort_duration` for LLM code to be ≥ 10 % greater than the human baseline and statistically significant, yet no task validates the ≥ 10 % increase condition.
Success Criterion SC-003 mandates that the effect size be ≥ 0.2, but no task checks or enforces this threshold after statistical analysis.
